Scalar cross-batch reductions (<g1, g2>, ||g1||^2, ||g2||^2, ||g_avg||^2) exhibit relative numerical error < 1.72e-06 compared to 64-bit double CPU reference.
Final in-place perturbed parameter array achieves max absolute element deviation < 5.96e-08 relative to CPU golden reference, satisfying the < 1e-06 tolerance.
Parameter scaling sweep across N in [10^5, 10^7] demonstrates effective HBM3 memory bandwidth scaling up to 1,657 GB/s.
